summary: Fix flips the public default `check_rank=False` → `True` so `hermite_normal_form` no longer silently drops rows on rank-deficient input; a defensible correctness-over-speed default change, but the docstring still documents the old default and the change was not otherwise noted. Second diff hunk is a whitespace-only no-op.

issues.description: Docstring for `check_rank` still states `(default False)` / describes old opt-in semantics; flipping the actual default to True without updating the documented default leaves the docs inconsistent with behavior.

Public API default parameter value change: existing callers relying on the fast `check_rank=False` assume-full-rank path now get different behavior/cost by default. Backward-compatibility nuance worth a changelog note.
New default forces the rank-check code path (modulo-D branch) always, adding an avoidable rank computation for the common full-rank case.
Second diff hunk re-touches the final `return ... .to_Matrix()` line with an identical string (whitespace/newline no-op); unrelated churn.
